contentSummary: about_us.html is the group-profile page: it tells the Sachdeva Group story (Alang since 1983, originally Madhav Industrial Corporation, rebranded Sachdeva Steel Products, Jai Jagdish Ship Breakers added 1998), states the operating scale (approx. 4,950 sqm of yard, 100,000+ LDT/year capacity, 37 + 36 ships recycled) and the regulatory frame it works inside (IMO, ILO, Basel Convention, Hong Kong Convention, EU SRR). It then declares a Vision and a Mission around green/sustainable ship recycling, profiles the two operating companies in prose, shows four short third-party testimonials from NYK Ship Management, ClassNK, JNA Japan and Keiji Tomoda, and closes with a six-slide certificate carousel…

blocks.summary: Empty page banner: <section class="page-title1 theme-before"></section> with zero child markup. Renders as a 400px-tall fixed-parallax strip using the CSS background images/about/about-head-bg1.png with a navy-to-teal 135deg gradient overlay (.theme-before::before, 70% opacity). Carries no H1, no breadcrumb, no eyebrow, no subtitle — pure decorative dead space above the content.
